files.README.md:
# springdata-mongodb-record-dtos-patch-cursor

Data access layer generated by [DB2CRUD](https://github.com/RaulEstevezA/DB2CRUD) for a database that already exists: entities, repositories and services with Spring Data MongoDB, in Java 21. It does not create or migrate the database, and it depends on no framework.

## Settings

- Database: mongodb.
- Entities: written for the tables the input had no class for.
- Services: take and return DTOs (records); updates take a Patch<T> per field: absent, null or a value.
- Transactions: one transaction per service operation, committed when it ends.
- Lists: lists return pages after a key (cursor).

## Layout

```text
src/main/java/app/Database.java        the MongoTemplate of DATABASE_URL
src/main/java/app/Documents.java       entities as documents, and what changed in them
src/main/java/app/UnitOfWork.java      the repositories of every table, and the transaction of each operation
src/main/java/app/errors/              NotFoundException, ConflictException, ValidationFailedException: no HTTP codes
src/main/java/app/<table>/             entity, repositories and service of each table
src/test/java/                       repositories against a database, services on the in-memory repositories
crud-contract.json                   what was written, for CRUD2Controller
```

## Running the tests

```bash
TEST_DATABASE_URL=mongodb://localhost:27017/app mvn test   # a real, disposable database: it is emptied
```

`Database.open()` makes one client for the application. In a Spring application, inject its own `MongoTemplate` into `MongoUnitOfWork` instead; transactions need a replica set.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
         xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 https://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd">
  <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>

  <groupId>app</groupId>
  <artifactId>springdata-mongodb-record-dtos-patch-cursor</artifactId>
  <version>0.1.0</version>
  <description>Data access layer (entities, repositories and services) generated by DB2CRUD.</description>

  <properties>
    <maven.compiler.release>21</maven.compiler.release>
    <project.build.sourceEncoding>UTF-8</project.build.sourceEncoding>
  </properties>

  <dependencies>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>org.springframework.data</groupId>
      <artifactId>spring-data-mongodb</artifactId>
      <version>5.1.3</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>org.mongodb</groupId>
      <artifactId>mongodb-driver-sync</artifactId>
      <version>5.8.1</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>org.junit.jupiter</groupId>
      <artifactId>junit-jupiter</artifactId>
      <version>6.1.3</version>
      <scope>test</scope>
    </dependency>
  </dependencies>

  <build>
    <plugins>
      <plugin>
        <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
        <artifactId>maven-surefire-plugin</artifactId>
        <version>3.5.4</version>
      </plugin>
    </plugins>
  </build>
</project>
